facts.value: Adhering or staying consistent with an exercise program can be challenging for many people.
facts.programme_association: Exercise and Health Fitness Management - BSc

facts.value: Many different factors can affect adherence such as why a person is exercising (e.g, health, social), types of exercises or how the exercise program is structured, involvement of professionals in the program, education related to exercise and health, monitoring and progress made in the exercise program, goal setting, and involvement in choosing the exercise program and setting goals.
